messages.content:
你是算法能力工厂的能力抽取专家。阅读一个历史项目中的 Python 函数，把它归纳为可复用的能力卡片。
kind 可选值：['imputer', 'encoder', 'scaler', 'feature', 'vectorizer', 'model']。
conditions 优先从以下标签中选择，确有必要时可新增 snake_case 标签：
- has_missing_values: 数据存在缺失值
- has_categorical_features: 存在类别型特征
- low_cardinality: 类别基数较低（适合 one-hot）
- high_cardinality: 类别基数较高（适合目标编码等）
- numeric_features: 存在数值型特征
- string_typed_numeric: 数值列被读成字符串（含空白等脏值）
- id_columns: 数据含客户 ID 等标识列
- linear_model: 下游为线性模型
- scaled_features: 要求特征已标准化
- nonlinear: 存在非线性关系
- mixed_features: 数值与类别特征混合
- large_tabular: 表格数据量较大
- imbalanced: 正负样本不平衡
- recall_first: 业务上召回优先
- interpretable: 要求结果可解释
- feature_importance: 需要输出特征重要性
- sparse_features: 高维稀疏特征
- text_input: 输入为文本
- time_tenure: 存在在网时长等时间长度字段

仓库：churn_v1  模块：encoding
签名：target_encode(train, test, col, target='churn', n_splits=5, smoothing=10)
依赖：['pandas', 'scikit-learn']
源码：
```python
def target_encode(train, test, col, target="churn", n_splits=5, smoothing=10):
    """对高基数类别列做 K 折目标编码（带平滑）。

    注意：必须只在训练集内做折外编码再映射到测试集，否则会标签泄漏。
    2024-03 的实验里曾在全量数据上直接编码，AUC 虚高到 0.97，上线后崩到 0.71。
    """
    prior = train[target].mean()
    train_enc = pd.Series(index=train.index, dtype=float)
    for fit_idx, val_idx in KFold(n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=0).split(train):
        stats = train.iloc[fit_idx].groupby(col)[target].agg(["mean", "count"])
        smooth = (stats["mean"] * stats["count"] + prior * smoothing) / (stats["count"] + smoothing)
        train_enc.iloc[val_idx] = train.iloc[val_idx][col].map(smooth).fillna(prior).values
    stats = train.groupby(col)[target].agg(["mean", "count"])
    smooth = (stats["mean"] * stats["count"] + prior * smoothing) / (stats["count"] + smoothing)
    return train_enc, test[col].map(smooth).fillna(prior)
```

Respond with a single JSON object only, no prose, conforming to this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"OperatorKind": {"enum": ["imputer", "encoder", "scaler", "feature", "vectorizer", "model"], "title": "OperatorKind", "type": "string"}}, "description": "LLM 对一个历史函数的能力归纳。", "properties": {"function": {"description": "原函数名", "title": "Function", "type": "string"}, "capability_type": {"description": "operator=可作为流水线步骤的数据变换/模型；metric=评价指标；utility=日志等辅助函数", "enum": ["operator", "metric", "utility"], "title": "Capability Type", "type": "string"}, "name": {"description": "CamelCase 英文能力名，例如 TotalChargesCleaner", "title": "Name", "type": "string"}, "kind": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/OperatorKind"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "description": "capability_type=operator 时必填"}, "description": {"description": "一句话中文描述，说明做什么、为什么", "title": "Description", "type": "string"}, "inputs": {"default": "", "title": "Inputs", "type": "string"}, "outputs": {"default": "", "title": "Outputs", "type": "string"}, "conditions": {"description": "适用条件标签，snake_case", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Conditions", "type": "array"}, "params": {"additionalProperties": true, "description": "关键参数及默认值", "title": "Params", "type": "object"}}, "required": ["function", "capability_type", "name", "description"], "title": "CapabilityCard", "type": "object"}

response:

  "inputs": "训练集DataFrame、测试集DataFrame、待编码类别列名、目标列名",
